summary: Validated the new self-host iteration: Setup wizard + strong password, Roles CRUD + built-in protection, Users-with-role + Viewer permission gating (UI + backend), Backup export + Restore round-trip. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_setup_roles_backup.py = 26 passed, 3 skipped (fresh-state zero-asserts intentionally skipped — DB had prior test data from pytest/UI runs; endpoint behaviour verified via the setup/export tests instead). Frontend: /setup -> /login redirect after setup done; admin sees Dashboard/Transactions/Reports/Settings + '+ New Entry'; Settings tabs show Bank Accounts, Funds, Categories, Payees, Chart of Accounts, Church Info, Roles, Users, Backup & Restore; Roles tab lists Administrator (Built-in; no edit/delete icons), Bookkeeper, Viewer; Add Role modal lists all 6 permissions with descriptions; created UIAssistant with transactions.view+transactions.manage, saved, deleted successfully; deleting Viewer (1 user assigned) is blocked with 'Roles assigned to users cannot be deleted until reassigned' error toast; Add User weak-password shows toast 'At least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a symbol'; Backup export downloads 11.5KB JSON with keys version/app/exported_at/data (2 users). Viewer login: NO Settings nav tab, NO 'New Entry' button on Transactions page; viewer tokens enforce 403 on POST /transactions, POST /accounts, GET /data/export; GET /transactions and GET /dashboard return 200. Restore round-trip (admin): export -> import same JSON -> re-login -> TEST_Checking account + TEST_backup_txn transaction preserved. Non-backup JSON correctly rejected 400.

issues: Minor: because tests re-created the same TEST_backup_txn across restore iterations, the list showed 4 duplicate rows after multiple restore round-trips. Not a bug — expected since restore merges backup contents into a cleared DB — but worth noting that duplicates arise only via repeated test runs, not normal user flow.

critical_code_review_comments: Setup wizard is correctly single-shot: /api/auth/setup returns 400 'Setup has already been completed' once admin exists. Good.
Strong-password rule is enforced in both /auth/setup and POST /auth/users — error message is clear and matches the UI live checklist spec.

Role deletion correctly checks assignment and returns a human-readable error ('Roles assigned to users cannot be deleted until reassigned'). Built-in Administrator role is protected in UI (no edit/delete icons) and backend (DELETE returns 400/403).
Permission enforcement is uniform: viewer gets 200 on view endpoints and 403 on write/data endpoints — matches resolve_permissions + require_permission dependency pattern.
Export payload is wrapped under {version, app, exported_at, data:{...}} — restore validates presence of users inside data and rejects a bare dict. Good safety check.
server.py is now 1300+ lines — reiterating prior iteration recommendation to split into modules (auth, roles/users, transactions, imports, attachments, reports, data). Not blocking.
Chart-of-accounts endpoint path is /api/coa (not /api/chart_of_accounts). Fine, just noting for frontend consistency.
No seeded bank accounts/payees/transactions on fresh install verified via setup-status + backend tests. Generic categories (12), one General Fund, generic COA seeded on setup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of targeted flows (setup redirect, admin nav, roles CRUD + protection, user weak-pw, viewer gating, backup export, restore round-trip)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup wizard is now COMPLETE — /api/auth/setup-status returns needs_setup=false. To exercise the wizard again you must wipe users+roles+coa (or ask for a fresh DB). Admin + Viewer users remain in DB; several TEST_Checking copies and duplicate TEST_backup_txn rows exist from restore round-trips. data-testids verified: setup-* (page not revisited now), nav-item-transactions/-settings, settings-tab-roles/users/backup, btn-add-role, perm-<key>, btn-save-role, btn-delete-role-<id>, btn-add-user, btn-save-user, btn-export-data, btn-quick-add-transaction (admin only). Chart-of-accounts endpoint is /api/coa. Pytest file uses -n 0 mode (shared module-level session_state) — do NOT run under xdist loadscope; use `pytest ... -n 0`.
